metadata.description: Plugins that find where code is expensive to change and measure whether changes made it cheaper.

plugins.name: cochange
plugins.description: Mines git history for hotspots, temporal coupling and change spread, and briefs agents before they edit.

plugins.name: complexity
plugins.description: Finds the functions that are hard to understand, guides simplifications that avoid shallow helpers, and guards CI against regressions.

plugins.name: structure
plugins.description: Finds dependencies that make change expensive: import cycles with minimal breaking sets, and dependencies pointing from stable towards volatile code, with an evidence pack for each. A second skill judges whether the packages are the right ones.

plugins.name: locality
plugins.description: Finds code that lives far from the code that uses it and recommends moving, inlining or splitting it.
